title: ccreality governed paths policy
description: Permissive ALLOW with surgical DENY of paths that would corrupt benchmarks or leak secrets. The hook's deny-on-no-allow-match gate (scripts/cc/hook_pre_tool_use_edit.sh) was REMOVED 2026-05-07 (operator directive: it was blocking legitimate edits). This file is still read by the MCP server's own path-policy enforcement (crates/context-graph-mcp/src/handlers/tools/reality_loop/path_policy.rs); allow:['**'] grants the loop full edit reach, while the deny list keeps SWE-bench oracles, reward specs, verifiers, and secrets off-limits at the MCP boundary. Schema: version=1, allow non-empty, deny non-empty.
